name: Hayama Hatoko
source:
Twin sister of Takako Hayama. In contrast to Takako, who has a stoic image, Hatoko is a flirtatious and unpredictable person, she is always in high spirits.

She is a member of the news club and is also a member of the school's in-house broadcasting program and reporter for the on-campus program “Gokigen Kurukku!"

Whenever there is an incident on campus, she appears out of nowhere and immediately starts reporting. She is a superhuman in a different sense from her sister, Takako.

[From [url=https://www.pulltop.com/gp07/02_chara09-01.html]official site[/url]]
